LANDING INTERRUPTED: Core commit 3568b38 and sase commits 6f18d2829, 880f1f863, bd83d3e60 implement the declaration contract, Python projection, source panels, badges, folding, and docs. Do not close sase-1af until the child epic lands, then rerun epic-symbols, close, symvision, and mark this plan done.

The linked plan's four phases match those beads, and the visual gap named in the interrupted landing note (100x30, Builtin-only, routine origins, key-to-paint) is the work sase-1af.5 verified in 8c9653df0. epic-symbols for sase-1af: none.
